tvs.text-bl-seo: Getting natural, beautiful brows is easier than you think. All you need to do is book a 3D or 6D eyebrow micropigmentation session at an affordable price, and then decide which technique to choose. The result will be excellent: your brows will look well-groomed, and you'll look stunning. What's more, eyebrow permanent makeup can hide various imperfections that bother you, such as a small scar or acne marks. That's why the 3D eyebrow tattoo is considered one of the most effective ways to visually restore the brow arch when the hairs are partially or completely missing.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
What is a 3D eyebrow tattoo and why is it called that?

The 3D technique gets its name from the final effect achieved after the procedure. By combining two techniques and several pigment shades, permanent makeup can fully recreate the brows and make them look as natural as possible. The artist can match or blend pigment shades from the darkest to the lightest to create a natural-looking final color. In the hair-stroke technique, the artist draws the hairs by hand. They can vary in length, thickness, growth direction and even color to create a natural effect, just like real hair. As soon as the brows are shaped to the desired thickness and length, the powder-effect eyebrow micropigmentation technique is used to create a base layer beneath the hair strokes. This way, we guarantee that the strokes won't look patchy and the whole look will be harmonious.
The 6D eyebrow tattoo technique is similar to 3D, but it gets its name from the fact that a larger number of shades can be used.

Benefits of the 3D/6D eyebrow tattoo technique

The main advantage of the technique is that it can camouflage completely or partially missing brows. This matters in cases of congenital anomalies or past illnesses, or when someone has very sparse, very light hair. 3D and 6D eyebrow micropigmentation can also help you:
hide any imperfections in the brow area, including deep scars – combining the two techniques covers everything that needs covering;
transform your look and feel more confident, thanks to well-groomed brows that always look neat;
save a considerable amount of personal time that used to go into daily makeup.

3D/6D brows: before and after the procedure

Although you don't need to study every detail of how to prepare for the procedure, you shouldn't ignore this step completely either. It's best not to pluck or tint your brows for a week before the procedure, and to avoid caffeinated drinks and alcohol the day before. Also, don't overdo medications, especially blood thinners. These should not be taken for 2 days before the procedure, and the same goes for hormonal medications. However, these suggestions don't apply after the procedure. It's important to pay even closer attention to the period after the procedure and follow your artist's recommendations:

  • Don't apply healing ointments. Let the skin heal on its own – it's better that way. To prevent infection, chlorhexidine or a similar product is recommended.
  • Don't steam your skin in any way. This includes saunas, sitting or lying in a hot bath for a long time, washing your face with hot water and going to the pool. Wash your face with lukewarm water and a gentle cleanser.
  • Avoid sunlight. Cover the tattooed area with a hat, a cap or sunglasses. You can apply SPF40+ sunscreen.
  • Don't touch, scratch or, under any circumstances, pick off flaking skin. Doing so will damage the tattoo, and you may re-injure the skin and cause suppuration or bleeding. This will prolong the healing of your 6D/3D permanent makeup and affect how your brows look.
  • Have the touch-up one month after the first session.

Is a touch-up mandatory after a 3D/6D eyebrow tattoo?

The touch-up is considered the second, follow-up stage of the procedure, so it shouldn't be skipped. It helps fix any flaws that may appear while the skin regenerates and also lets you slightly adjust the look of your brows if you wish. For example, the brows can be made a little wider, thicker or darker. In addition, re-introducing pigment into the skin makes your eyebrow permanent makeup stay visible for longer.

Stages of the 3D eyebrow permanent makeup procedure

The procedure includes the following stages:

  1. Creating the sketch. The artist draws the hairs by hand so that the shape, length and density of the brow are clearly visible. The sketch is useful both for you and for the artist, who will follow it exclusively while doing the makeup. That's why it's important to reach a mutual agreement and choose the perfect design for your future brows.
  2. Performing the procedure. Step by step, the artist draws each hair, giving it a natural look. Once the hair-stroke tattoo is finished, the artist moves on to the second technique – powder micropigmentation, which completes the final look. An anesthetic is used during tattooing. It reduces pain and skin redness.
  3. At the end of the procedure, the artist will give you detailed skin care advice and book you in for a touch-up.

Recommendations and contraindications

This technique is ideal for women with sparse or blonde brows, or with partially or completely missing brows. However, that's not a limit: any woman who wants to look well-groomed and feminine can benefit from 3D permanent makeup. Before booking the procedure, though, keep in mind that it has some contraindications. These include:

  • pregnancy and breastfeeding, because the anesthetic used contains lidocaine;
  • type 1 or type 2 diabetes;
  • epilepsy;
  • nervous system disorders;
  • viral illnesses;
  • HIV, AIDS;
  • inflammation of the skin in the brow area;
  • cuts or unhealed wounds.

Relative contraindications include feeling unwell, fever or high blood pressure – in these cases, it's best to postpone the procedure and let your artist know in advance.
3D/6D eyebrow micropigmentation pays off in every way. Besides the obvious time savings on daily makeup, it gives you an attractive look and self-confidence. After all, beautiful brows instantly transform your appearance and make your face more expressive. migx_questions.questions-title: What makes the 3D/6D tattoo technique different from other techniques?
migx_questions.questions-text: The 3D tattoo technique differs from the others in that it combines two techniques at once: hair-stroke and powder. Besides combining techniques, several shades can be used at the same time during the procedure to lighten, darken and highlight the color of the hair strokes. The method is used to achieve brows that look as natural as possible.

migx_questions.questions-title: Who is the 3D microblading brows technique suitable for?
migx_questions.questions-text: There are absolutely no restrictions or special recommendations. A 3D tattoo suits any woman who wants gorgeous brows. This technique is ideal for people whose brows are partially or completely missing.

migx_questions.questions-title: How long does a 3D/6D tattoo last?
migx_questions.questions-text: Up to 2 years. How long the effect lasts depends on your skin type and age, your lifestyle and other individual factors. For some people, the tattoo can last up to 2.5–3 years, while for others it lasts up to 1–1.5 years.
The procedure is painless thanks to a numbing cream. It reduces pain, redness and skin inflammation.
